instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the website clearly highlights 'WHOLESALE ONLY' across top banners, product cards, and checkout to avoid retail buyer confusion.
Implement real-time MOQ checking in the cart and order submission flow.
Use exact contact placeholders '+91 XXXXX XXXXX' and 'hello@kapdagodam.in' where requested.
Mention owners Shamsuddin Idrisi & Tabrez Idrisi prominently in About Us, Contact, and Footer sections.
Make sure all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, filters, tabs, status dropdowns) carry explicit 'data-testid' attributes for reliable automated testing.
Use Sonner for toasts (located in components/ui/sonner) for smooth feedback on cart addition, MOQ validation errors, and order submission.
Maintain high contrast dark UI with polished gold accents and clean industrial denim aesthetic.
